items.q: It was only after the band shot down to the seven pieces that Yank would accompany me.

ctx.x: So, the question is can we can the same thing about Billy Butterfield?

So it's more than likely that it's Billy Butterfield, because Yank would not necessarily accompany me on these things. It was only after the band shot down to the seven pieces that Yank would accompany me.
